definitions.explanation: The process or industry of making paper from raw materials such as wood pulp. Composed of {製|せい} (manufacture) + {紙|し} (paper).

examples.japanese: {製紙|せいし}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visited a paper manufacturing plant.

examples.japanese: {製紙|せいし}{業界|ぎょうかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The paper manufacturing industry is required to address environmental issues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和紙|わし}→和紙：02268_washi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製紙|せいし}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ユネスコ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無形|むけい}→無形：13572_mukei⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}{遺産|いさん}→文化遺産：17353_bunkaisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The papermaking technique for washi has been registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

notes:
USAGE:
{製紙|せいし} is primarily used as a modifier before other nouns: {製紙|せいし}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧ (paper mill), {製紙|せいし}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (paper company). It refers to the industrial process, not the act of making paper by hand (which is more specifically {紙漉|かみす}き).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製紙|せいし}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧ (paper mill)
- {製紙|せいし}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (paper company)
- {製紙|せいし}{業|ぎょう} (paper manufacturing industry)
- {製紙|せいし}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (papermaking technology)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{和紙|わし}→和紙：02268_washi⟧ is traditional Japanese handmade paper.
- ⟦{洋紙|ようし}→洋紙：16912_youshi⟧ is Western-style machine-made paper.
- {紙漉|かみす}き refers to the traditional craft of making paper by hand.
